theory: A graph consists of a set of vertices (nodes) connected by edges. Graphs can be directed or undirected, weighted or unweighted, and cyclic or acyclic. They model complex relationships like social networks, road maps, and dependency systems. Key traversal algorithms include Depth-First Search (DFS) and Breadth-First Search (BFS), while pathfinding uses Dijkstra's and Bellman-Ford algorithms.
